name: taskflow-board
description: A local four-lane task board that links Codex conversations with safe Git worktree workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Codex tasks across idea, plan, execute, and verify.
interface.longDescription: Taskflow Board is a local-first Kanban workspace for Codex. It keeps task IDs, project paths, linked conversation IDs, verification evidence, and temporary Git worktree branches together in four focused lanes.
